title: What to Pack

content: Hippocrates is a casual environment and guests should wear whatever makes them comfortable. Shorts, sundresses, jeans, t-shirts, flip flops, leggings, sweaters, etc. are all appropriate. West Palm Beach is warm and tends to be humid in the summer.  Winter months are typically warm during the day with cooler temps in the evening, but we can experience an occasional ‘cold’ spell.  At times, we do get rain so it is a good idea to bring some light rain gear.  It's best to check weather reports before packing. Some guests like to dress up for graduation or to go off-campus, and all of our buildings offer air conditioning, so please pack accordingly. And don’t forget your bathing suit, exercise clothing and gym shoes! Please click here for the average temperature in West Palm Beach year-round. Please watch this pre-arrival video to learn more about what to bring, what to leave behind and what to expect upon arrival.
